name: Hibino Matsuri
source:
She is the leader of a group of three part-time JK students. They act on their own initiative and often cause trouble. 

She has a cheerful personality, but is clumsy with her hands and loose with time. Her grades at school are poor, and her sloppy clothes and attitude toward life have made her a target of her teachers. 

She likes good-looking men, and when she sees a good-looking man among the customers at the store, she tries to pick him up without thinking about her work.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk006/bm01/]official site[/url]]
